Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner turn after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly deduced that Hughesville, Maryland is in Calvert County based on a "map/geocode reference" from the search results. This was an error because Hughesville, MD is actually located in Charles County. The Planner failed to verify the county affiliation of the city found (Hughesville) using authoritative sources before proceeding, leading to a persistent and incorrect conclusion (Calvert County) that was later contradicted by the correct answer (Charles County).
